freshnessNote: Word for word, because the numbers are the claim. Two runs are pinned. `freshness` is over the fixture's own log, which holds a commit that touched docs/arch with an older commit behind it, so a row reading anything other than what is written here means the cut at the contract commit stopped happening. `freshnessUncommittedContract` is over the same log with that one commit filtered out, which is the case of a contract nobody has committed yet, and every part must read that nothing has landed. The second run exists because the first fix of this defect passed the first check and still handed back the whole history in the second case.
